clips.title: The story
paras: In Deathknell, the Hallowed Scroll calls newly risen Forsaken priests to the chapel. Shadow Priest Sarvis gives the summons, sending each novice to Dark Cleric Duesten to learn how the Forsaken wield faith after death.

Newly awakened undead stagger from Deathknell’s graves, their minds reeling from plague, death, and freedom from the Lich King's grip. For those who followed the Holy Light in life, death leaves deep confusion. As fledgling undead fight the mindless Scourge at the settlement’s edge, Shadow Priest Sarvis receives messages. A summons marked by Dark Cleric Duesten calls newly risen priests away from their wandering and into the desecrated town chapel.

At the chapel, Dark Cleric Duesten teaches a harsh faith. He says the Holy Light abandoned the Forsaken in death, ancestral spirits are hollow tales, and demons have no care for their plight. Forsaken clergy teach that willpower and self-reliance are their only sources of salvation. Under Duesten’s guidance, newly risen priests learn to wield divine discipline and shadow through conviction in their own survival, not devotion to distant gods.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the priest trainer Duesten. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Ah, so between fire, plague, rioting, and much worse, one more of the "faithful" comes to my door. Well, let me bid you welcome, adventurer. And allow me a moment to explain a thing or two before you decide it's time for you to seek whatever drives you forward: the Holy Light no longer concerns you, the spirits of your forefathers are fairy tales, and creatures from the Nether don't want you.
Do you understand me so far?

clips.title: Completion
paras: There is only one thing you must know: we have survived through will alone. It is faith in ourselves that separates us from others, and with our powers, we will cause great change in all of Azeroth. The weak will come to lean on you. The lepers will call you Lord. And the ignorant will look to you for guidance. It is my duty to make sure you have the necessary tools so when the time comes, you are prepared. As you grow in experience, seek me out. I will teach you greater powers if you are ready.
